verdict_reason: The contact address steps are removed and the run lands on check your answers correctly, but the edited steps repeat sequences the journey flow and two sibling specs already hold.

todos.issue: The edited 'CPH number with validation errors' step (148-152: cphNumber Save and continue, wait for addresses, addresses Continue, wait for check your answers, openCurrentOverview) is the same leave-the-addresses-hub sequence pasted into notification-journey-filled-state.spec.ts:106-110 and notification-journey-initial-state.spec.ts:117-122; and 'Continue to declaration' (219-223) re-types the review-to-declaration steps that AnimalsJourney already owns in openReviewFromOverview / fromOverviewToDeclaration (journey.ts:280, 1056).
todos.fix: Must: the steps that leave the addresses hub through check your answers back to Overview, and the steps from Overview through the review to the declaration, each live once on AnimalsJourney and all three a11y journey specs call them. One way: add a public AnimalsJourney method (e.g. continueFromAddressesToOverview) and make fromOverviewToDeclaration public, then call them here and in the filled and initial specs.
